title: Tam Giao House in Kien Viet Magazine
description: Tam Giao House by MVN Architecture & Construction was featured in Kien Viet Magazine, highlighting a design philosophy centered on the harmony between old and new, nature and architecture, and the connection between people and their living environment.
author: MVN Group
content:
Kien Viet Magazine has published an article featuring Tam Giao House, a project designed and constructed by MVN Architecture & Construction.

The project is shaped by three core values throughout the design process: the harmony between old and new, the interaction of natural elements including light, wind, and water, and the connection between people. These principles are expressed through open spatial organization, climate-responsive solutions, and the thoughtful selection of materials that respond to the urban context of Da Nang.

Project Information
Project Name: Tam Giao House
Location: Lien Chieu District, Da Nang City, Vietnam
Building Area: 97.5 m²
Total Floor Area: 267.5 m²
Lead Architect: M.Arch. Architect Truong Anh Vuong
Design & Construction: MVN Architecture & Construction
Completion Year: 2020
